# StackStats

> Advanced analytics for Substack writers. A local desktop app (Mac & Windows) that shows you what Substack's dashboard never will — engagement segments, cohort retention, churn risk, superfan detection, content-to-growth correlation, and best time to post. Runs 100% locally. One-time purchase, no subscription.

StackStats is built by Rishikesh Sharan, a Substack writer who publishes "10+1 Things" (a weekly curated links newsletter). It reads your Substack CSV exports locally and computes deep analytics that Substack does not expose in their native dashboard. No cloud processing, no accounts, no recurring fees.

Current version: v1.5.2 (released March 25, 2026).
